share.title: Share report with a link
share.intro: Anyone with the link can view the report without logging in. The link can be revoked at any time.
share.lockDates: Lock the dates: <hint>the link always shows exactly this period (unlocked = the period rolls, e.g. always "this month")</hint>

toolbar.dateOrder: The from date must be before the to date

templateBar.deleteConfirm: Do you want to delete the template "{name}"?

schedule.title: Schedule report
schedule.intro: The template {name} is sent automatically by email. The period rolls (e.g. always "last month").
schedule.saveFirst: Save the report as a template first. The schedule is tied to a saved template so the period can roll automatically.

customize.tagNote: Entries with several tags are counted in each group. The sum can exceed the total. Entries without a tag are collected under "No tag".
customize.budgetNote: The budget column is only shown when grouping by project or by client and project.
customize.pausesNote: Breaks are gaps of at least 15 minutes between timestamped entries, calculated per team member per day. Entries without a start and end time cannot be included and are counted separately.
customize.title: Title

preview.chooseDates: Choose a start and end date
preview.chooseDatesHint: Enter both dates to see the report
preview.emptyHint: Try another period or remove filters
preview.seeEntries: See the time entries behind the number
preview.budgetTitle: The month's total usage on the project ({month}), independent of the report's filters
preview.budgetTitleNone: The monthly budget is only shown when the whole period lies within one calendar month, and only for projects with a budget
preview.pausesExplain: Gaps of at least {minutes} minutes between timestamped entries, calculated per team member per day.
preview.untimed: {count, plural, one {# entry without a start and end time is not included.} other {# entries without a start and end time are not included.}}
preview.noPauses: No breaks above the threshold in the period.

profitability.title: What do you actually earn?
profitability.description: Real hourly rate per client: earned money divided by ALL hours used, including the non-billable ones
profitability.internalHours: {hours} hours of internal time (no client) in the period
profitability.internalLost: Sold at your default rate they would be {amount} DKK. Use the figure as a guide, not as bookkeeping
profitability.noClientTime: No client time in the period
profitability.noClientTimeHint: Log time on clients and the report shows what you really earn per hour.
profitability.unbilledHours: {hours} h of billable time not yet settled
profitability.bad: {pct}% of your rate. Raise the price, sell prepaid packages or drop
profitability.warn: {pct}% of your rate. Keep an eye on the internal time
profitability.footnote: Real hourly rate = settled money (invoiced + prepaid package deductions) ÷ all logged hours on the client since {from}. Hours not yet settled pull the figure down. Invoice them, or see them as the price of the client.

utilization.title: Utilisation rate
utilization.description: Billable time, occupancy and coverage against working time, per team member and as a team trend
utilization.needsAdmin: Requires an organisation and the admin role
utilization.workTimeHr: Standard time from the employee profile
utilization.noTimeLogged: No time logged in the period
utilization.footnote: Billable share = billable hours ÷ all logged hours. Occupancy rate = billable hours ÷ working time. Coverage rate = logged hours ÷ working time. The working time is the same as in the coverage rate: the employee's weekly schedule, or the standard time from the employee profile when the enterprise module is on. Rejected time is not counted. The period is {from} up to and including {to}.

teamProfit.title: Team profitability
teamProfit.description: Revenue minus internal cost price, per team member and per project
teamProfit.needsAdmin: Requires an organisation and the admin role
teamProfit.adminOnly: Team profitability is for the owners and administrators of organisations. Cost prices are sensitive data.
teamProfit.noTime: No time logged in the period
teamProfit.noProjectTime: No project time in the period
teamProfit.footnote: Revenue = billable hours × rate. Cost = hours × internal cost price (snapshot per time entry; the member's current rate when the entry is older than the cost price feature). Set cost prices under the project's team rates or member administration. Sorted lowest margin first, since {from}.
teamProfit.costDescription: Cost price per hour per team member (salary + overhead). Used only in this report and does not affect billing rates.
